scope: Model-free public-news readiness layering for the 44 currently executable U45 members. Retrieval and deterministic <=7-day issuer-title relevance are measured separately; event classification and formal news acceptance remain fail-closed.

readiness_contract.retrieval_ready: At least one parsed public source returned items.
readiness_contract.relevance_ready: At least one deduplicated item within the 7-day window contains a frozen issuer term in the title.
readiness_contract.event_ready: Requires separately accepted material-event classification; always fail-closed in this run.
readiness_contract.formal_news_ready: Requires formal U news-evidence acceptance; always fail-closed in this run.

resolved_prior_gap.interpretation: Official-name fallback resolved retrieval transport, but no <=7-day issuer-title item passed relevance; do not infer no material news.

dedupe.method: SHA-256 of normalized case-folded title plus published timestamp
dedupe.note: Same title at different publication timestamps is not forcibly collapsed.

next_actions: Preserve retrieval_ready=44/44 executable as transport evidence only.
For the five relevance-ready members, add deterministic/traceable material-event classification without auto-promoting formal news readiness.
For the other 39 executable members, do not interpret relevance-negative as no-news; continue source/alias expansion only where evidence justifies it.
Continue seeking a new independent complete O Gate A sample; Gate B/C and O full-pool remain frozen.
